code-block.name: Code Block
code-block.purpose: Render code, token paths, command snippets, and structured source examples with readable typography, overflow behavior, optional language metadata, and accessible copy/source affordances.

anatomy.rule: Surface that owns border, background, radius, density, and overflow without page-local wrappers.
Optional metadata row for language, filename, status, or copy action.
Monospace readable content with preserved whitespace, wrapping policy, and scroll behavior.
Optional Copy Button composes the copy behavior and feedback.

variants.description: Compact grouped token or command snippets.
Documentation specimen for tokens, APIs, or generated outputs.

code-block.statePrecedence: disabled > error > copied > with-copy > with-header > scrollable > wrapped > default

Voice.decision: Use clear labels for language, filename, and copy feedback.
Voice.behavior: Users understand what the snippet represents before copying.
Voice.test: Verify visible or accessible label describes source context.
Voice.rejectIf: Snippet context is only implied by visual placement.

Frame.decision: Use Flow spacing, radius, density, and overflow rules.
Frame.behavior: Long snippets do not break the page layout.
Frame.test: Verify mobile overflow and wrapping behavior.
Frame.rejectIf: The code block causes horizontal page overflow.

Depth.decision: Use surface hierarchy rather than decorative shadows.
Depth.behavior: Code reads as reference content, not a floating card.
Depth.test: Verify surface contrast in light and dark modes.

State.decision: Expose copied, error, disabled, wrapped, and scrollable states explicitly.
State.behavior: Snippet state and copy feedback are machine-readable.
State.test: Verify copied and error messages are announced.

Accessibility.decision: Provide code semantics, readable contrast, keyboard access to copy action, and non-color feedback.
Accessibility.behavior: Keyboard and assistive technology users can read and copy snippets.
Accessibility.test: Verify accessible label, focus order, contrast, and copy feedback.
Accessibility.rejectIf: Raw pre/code is used without labeling or overflow governance.

props.name: code
props.notes: Raw code or token text to render.

productExamples.example: API prop examples and generated usage snippets.
Token path and generated Style Dictionary output.
OTP/security code presentation remains an email pattern, not the public Code Block component.

do: Use for source, token, command, API, or generated-output snippets.
Provide a language or context label when the code is not obvious.
Compose Copy Button for copyable snippets.
dont: Do not use raw pre/code as a page-local visual block.
Do not use for OTP/security codes inside email templates.
Do not let long snippets resize page layout.
info: Email OTP code blocks remain governed by Email Template Layout because email HTML has channel-specific constraints.

tests: Dark mode surface and code color.
agentInstructions: Use Code Block for documentation code snippets, token paths, commands, and generated output.
Do not copy the internal EmailTemplateLayout CodeBlock as the public component contract.
Reject local raw pre/code wrappers once Code Block exists.
rejectIf: The use is an email OTP/security code block.
Raw pre/code is styled locally after Code Block is available.
The snippet lacks context when copied text could be ambiguous.
